iPhone 18 Pro is just a couple months away from launching, and more details on the new product keep leaking—including colors. Here are the three new iPhone 18 Pro colors according to leaker Instant Digital.

Dark Cherry, Light Blue, and Silver could be the only iPhone 18 Pro colors, with no Black option

Last year in the run-up to the iPhone 17 Pro unveiling, rumors indicated there could be up to five new color options—more than ever before.

Instead, Apple surprised everyone by launching only three colors: Cosmic Orange, Deep Blue, and Silver. The omission of a darker gray or black option was especially noteworthy.

This year, iPhone 18 Pro rumors have gone back and forth regarding how many colors are coming, and whether black will be among them.

The latest update comes from Weibo leaker Instant Digital. In a new post, he says iPhone 18 Pro will offer three colors:

  • Dark Cherry
  • Light Blue
  • Silver-Gray

If true, this would align well with Apple’s color approach from last year.

Dark Cherry will be the standout color option in all the marketing, like Cosmic Orange was for iPhone 17 Pro. Light Blue will replace Deep Blue. And the new Silver will be similar to last year’s, but perhaps a different shade.

And again, this would mean no black option for iPhone 18 Pro.

Two months out, we can’t say for sure what Apple will choose to do. But whether it launches three colors or four, there’s at least consensus on what some of the color options will be.

Which new iPhone 18 Pro color catches your attention most? Let us know in the comments.
